To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the timestamp ordering algorithm performs better than the two-phase locking algorithm when a mix of long and short transactions is executed, while the two-phase locking scheduler performs better than the timestamp ordering scheduler when the workload is composed of short transactions only.
the performance of a distributed object-oriented database system is influenced by many factors and that it is important to consider the workload when choosing a concurrency control method.
a timestamp ordering scheduler is better for throughput and that a two-phase locking is more fair to long transactions.

concurrency control in distributed database systems.
simulating the performance of distributed database systems.
the development of a simulator for distributed object-oriented database systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

a distributed object-oriented database system should use a timestamp ordering scheduler for mixed transactions, and a two-phase locking scheduling for a system where the majority of transactions are long transactions.
the choice of concurrency control algorithm depends on the workload and data distribution.
it is difficult to make generalizations about the relative performance of different schedulers, and that the choice of scheduler should be based on the application and the workload.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the timestamp ordering algorithm is the better choice for a distributed database system with a mix of short and long transactions, whereas a two-phase locking algorithm is better for a system with only short transactions.
a timestamp ordering scheduler is a good choice for a distributed database system that is expected to be mostly read-intensive.
timestamp ordering is the best choice when the workload is a mix of small transactions and long transactions.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the choice of concurrency control algorithm is important for the performance of a database system.
simulation is a useful tool for analyzing the performance of distributed database systems.

the DBsim simulator can be used to evaluate and simulate the performance of different concurrency control algorithms, data distribution and architectural options in a distributed object-oriented database system.
